Package org.apache.juneau.http.response

Class Created.Unmodifiable

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.http.response.BasicHttpResponse<Created>
org.apache.juneau.http.response.Created
org.apache.juneau.http.response.Created.Unmodifiable
All Implemented Interfaces:
HttpResponseMessage, UnmodifiableBean
Enclosing class:
Created
public static class Created.Unmodifiable extends Created implements UnmodifiableBean
Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing Created response.

Its only behavioral override is modify(Runnable), which throws — because all mutation is funneled through modify(...), this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.

      Single mutation funnel — the only choke-point through which all state changes on this bean flow.
